skill.name: tiktok-content-research
skill.description: Search TikTok posts through SocialDataX, compare content samples, and document the evidence behind research observations.
skill.summary: Find and compare TikTok post samples by keyword.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most backtick matches are Markdown, but the skill directs users and agents to run an unpinned third-party CLI that handles API credentials. The workflow does not define how to keep search inputs separate from shell code or require approval for paid searches. No evidence of embedded secrets, deliberate exfiltration, or an attempt to override this audit was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI execution with credential access
remediation.suggestion: Replace floating package references with a reviewed release and verify package integrity. Require approval before installing or running it with credentials.

remediation.issue: CLI credentials persist in a local file
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an operating system credential store or approved secret manager. Document how to remove saved credentials and rotate a key if it is exposed.

remediation.issue: Shell examples do not separate search inputs from code
remediation.suggestion: Pass each keyword and page token as a separate argument without a shell. Treat provider responses as data.

remediation.issue: Paid searches lack an explicit approval boundary
remediation.suggestion: Confirm a credit budget before the first paid request. Count pagination and retries against that budget, and require approval to resume after a balance error.

content.value_statement: Finding relevant TikTok posts and comparing their themes takes time. Use SocialDataX to collect a focused sample and separate observed evidence from your interpretation.
actual_capabilities: Search TikTok posts by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or a configured MCP connection.
Filter CLI searches to videos or image posts.
Cap CLI search results by page count or item count.
Resume the same CLI search using a returned continuation token when available.
Report available links, content IDs, authors, dates, and metrics separately from research observations.
limitations: Requires a configured SocialDataX connection. The CLI needs Node.js, network access, and a service API key.
Searches can consume SocialDataX credits. A CLI credential check does not verify request authorization or account balance.
Search results are samples, not a complete inventory of posts or accounts.
The research workflow is read-only for TikTok and does not post, like, comment, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Find themes for a content brief
use_cases.description: Collect a small sample of posts and group them by topic before proposing ideas to test.

use_cases.title: Compare brand content samples
use_cases.description: Search for two brands, compare their visible formats and themes, and cite the posts behind each observation.

use_cases.title: Explore a video topic
use_cases.description: Review a small video sample for a niche keyword and identify questions that the sample does not answer.

prompt_templates.title: Find a first sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for TikTok posts about desk organization. Use one page and list relevant titles, creators, and links or IDs when available.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a small sample for a new topic.

prompt_templates.title: Filter to videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 10 TikTok videos about apartment gardening. Group relevant results by topic and cite one example per group.
prompt_templates.scenario: You want to compare themes within one post format.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [Brand A] and [Brand B] separately with a one-page limit each. Compare their visible formats and themes, and distinguish observations from assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a traceable comparison for a brand brief.

prompt_templates.title: Collect a bounded research sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [keyword] with a maximum of two pages and 20 posts. Confirm the credit budget before searching. Report available metrics, source references, and any gaps. If results are partial, resume only with a valid token and remaining budget.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a documented sample for a research report.

output_examples.input: Use one page to explore desk organization videos.
output: Illustrative result: The sample contains videos about cable storage and drawer layouts.
Observation: Two videos show a desk before and after reorganizing it.
Follow-up: Compare before-and-after videos with step-by-step tutorials in a new sample.

output_examples.input: Compare small samples for two reusable bottle brands.
output: Illustrative result: Brand A appears in cleaning demonstrations. Brand B appears in packing videos.
Limit: These keyword samples do not show how often either brand uses those formats.
Follow-up: Verify which posts were published by the brands before attributing a strategy.

best_practices: Start with one page and agree on a credit budget before expanding.
Keep source links or content IDs alongside observations and label any missing fields.
Use an approved connection and enter API keys only through a trusted local or managed credential flow.
anti_patterns: Treating keyword results as a complete account history or proof of a platform-wide trend.
Sharing API keys, authorization headers, or credential files in chat or logs.
Restarting a partial search from page one without checking the remaining budget and available continuation token.

faq.question: What can I provide as input?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword or topic. You can include a brand, account name, or audience in the search phrase.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a SocialDataX key. An authenticated hosted MCP connection can reuse its existing credentials.

faq.question: Does a search use credits?
faq.answer: SocialDataX searches can use credits. The documented CLI credential status check is not billed.

faq.question: Can I search only for videos or images?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI can filter to video posts or image posts. Without a filter, it searches both types.

faq.question: Can I collect every matching post?
faq.answer: No. Search does not have a stable complete result set. Use page or item limits and report the scope of your sample.

faq.question: Can this skill access or change my TikTok account?
faq.answer: The workflow does not sign into TikTok, read local browser data, or post, like, comment, or change an account.
